Name: Pistachio Point
Author: Lykkio
Description:
I was working on and playing with this map for a while and thought it might be fun to release for the anniversary :) Yay Stardew!

Available as an added farm or a standard farm replacer (for mobile).

I can't stop making beach maps and am forever tempted by the new features added to MMAP, so here is another beachy expanse with extra atmosphere and a few critters. The farmhouse isn't modified, no extra gifts, however you do get a substantial starting bonus by having every fruit tree already on the map.

The warps are mildly non-conventional: entering the forest is a teleport, not walking off the map. Everything should be horse friendly. The cave is hidden behind the waterfall on the beach.

*You can also walk under most of the leafage behind the farmhouse, just not the hidden water spot

A couple of custom warp location suggestions for SVE users: (61, 7) (83, 3) (61, 40) (32, 31) (57, 23)
